models.description: The family's models, each a key of platforms in ops/bootstrap/hardware-classes.yaml. Either a list of keys, which says nothing about any model (every field unknown), or a mapping of each key to its entry (design section 3.1).

state.description: Whether goat runs the release on the model: measured (run and recorded), built (goat's path for it exists, not measured), designed, not built, not supported (the model's vendor stack does not offer it), unknown.

unlock.description: How the encrypted disk opens at boot. tpm2: Clevis bound to the TPM in the initramfs. tang: Clevis bound to a Tang server on the network. yubikey-hmac: a YubiKey challenge-response. usb-key: a key file on removable media. console-passphrase: typed at the console. ssh-passphrase: typed over SSH into the initramfs (dropbear). cloud-kms: the cloud provider's key service opens the volume. phone-unlock: the phone's own lock screen.

ubuntu.description: Each Ubuntu release and its state on the model. 24.04 and 26.04 are always stated.

scope.description: What the model's preparation encrypts: root (the root filesystem, and with it everything on that disk), data (a data volume such as /opt/docker-data, the root not), none, unknown. A type's encryption is delivered only by root.

recovery.description: How the disk opens when the unlock fails.

extras.description: Kernel modules, libraries and configuration the model needs beyond its OS image, one line each.

builder.description: The golden-path builder: a path in this repository, or 'none: ' and the reason.

directions.description: Written directions for the model, a path in this repository.

end_state.description: What goatbuilder doctor --target --live holds a machine of the model to beyond the fields above (crates/goatbuilder/src/small_computer.rs): what the board's /proc/device-tree/model starts with, the kind of disk the root is on, and where FIPS mode holds (userspace: the OpenSSL FIPS provider alone; kernel: the kernel's as well).
